summary_1line: At dawn Ravana, lavishly attended by intoxicated women, enters the Ashoka grove seeking Sita while Hanuman secretly observes from hiding.

image_candidates.scene_text: Ravana, crowned and adorned with jewels, strides into the Ashoka grove at dawn surrounded by lamp-bearing women while hidden Hanuman watches from leafy branches above.
A procession of drowsy, wine-flushed women carrying golden lamps, fans, and a jeweled cup follows Ravana through flower-strewn forest paths beneath gem-studded arches.
Hanuman crouches among dense leaves, staring down as the ten-headed Ravana glows in lamplight like the moon among stars amid his retinue of women.
